name: opper-vscode
description: Use any of Opper's 700+ models — plus your pools and dynamic routes — in VS Code chat, routed through the EU-hosted Opper gateway.

commands.title: Choose What to List (Models, Pools, Routes)

opper.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Opper API. Point this at a self-hosted or regional gateway if you run one; the extension appends `/v3/...` itself.

opper.showModels.markdownDescription: List concrete catalog models — a specific provider's row, e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5`. Untick this and leave **Show Pools** / **Show Dynamic Routes** on to reduce the picker to Opper's own routing constructs.

opper.showPools.markdownDescription: List Opper **pools** — bare model names such as `claude-sonnet-4.5` that load-balance across every provider serving that model. A pool only advertises a capability its every member has.

opper.showDynamicRoutes.markdownDescription: List your org's deployed **dynamic routes** as `dynamic/<name>`. The routing graph picks the model per request.

opper.dynamicRouteToolCalling.markdownDescription: Advertise dynamic routes as tool-calling capable. Opper cannot know this ahead of time — the graph picks the model per request — so this is a promise you make on your route's behalf. Turn it off if a route can land on a model without tool support; the route then stays out of agent mode instead of failing mid-turn.

opper.euOnly.markdownDescription: Only list models Opper reports as hosted in the EU (`opper.region == "EU"`). Pools are included only when *every* member is EU-hosted.

opper.zdrOnly.markdownDescription: Only list models with zero data retention by default (`opper.zdr == "always"`). Models where ZDR is merely available under enterprise terms are excluded.

opper.modelFilter.markdownDescription: If non-empty, list only model ids containing one of these substrings (case-insensitive), e.g. `["claude", "gpt-5"]`. Keeps the picker short when the full catalogue is more than you need.

opper.login.clientId.description: Registered public OAuth client ID dedicated to VS Code. No client secret.

opper.login.simulator.description: Enable proposed renewal contract for a loopback simulator only. Not a deployed API contract.
